name: Dune Scrufpea
desc: Dune Scrufpea (Ladeania lanceolata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 12 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ladeania lanceolata is a species of flowering plant in the legume family known by several common names, including lemon scurfpea, wild lemonweed, and dune scurfpea.
